title: ALPagination (al-pagination)
description:
Component: al-pagination
- **slot** "label": If content is slotted, it will override the default pagination label
- **slot** "prev": If content is slotted, it will override the default "previous" icon
- **slot** "next": If content is slotted, it will override the default "next" icon

slots.name: label
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will override the default pagination label

slots.description: If content is slotted, it will override the default "previous" icon

slots.name: next
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will override the default "next" icon

prevButtonText.description: Text displayed on the previous button

nextButtonText.description: Text displayed on the next button

Aria label attribute for accessibility
Provides an accessible name for the navigation element

totalRecords.description:
